(define (analyze-field-behavior F pt name)
  (let ((div (calc/divergence F pt))
        (curl (calc/curl F pt)))
    (cond ((pair? div) (escalate 'singular-field name))
          ((and (pair? curl) (eq? (car curl) 'escalate))
           (escalate 'malformed-field name))
          (else (begin
            (display (list name "div:" div "curl:" curl))
            (list name div curl))))))
